strings.act.choice.text.1: Is it over? Arceus, awaking from its control, looks expectantly at the restored Heart of Sinnoh you hold in your hands.
strings.act.choice.text.2: But with this power, surely the world could be changed... for the better? Someone like Cyrus would never be able to rise again... right?
strings.act.choice.text.3: Hero of Sinnoh: Return the Heart to Arceus.
strings.act.choice.text.4: Traitor of Sinnoh: Claim the Heart of Sinnoh. Challenge and defeat each of your fellow trainers in battle to be crowned as the undisputed strongest trainer.
strings.act.heart.text.1: Without the power of the Heart, Arceus falls under the control of Cyrus and the world begins to reshape itself according to the machinations of its new God.
strings.act.heart.text.2: Restore the Heart of Sinnoh at the Origin Shrine then proceed to the Temple of Sinnoh to confront Cyrus.
strings.act.heart.text.3: Objective: Defeat Cyrus at the Temple of Sinnoh.
strings.act.heart.text.5: Once one trainer completes this objective: They draw the Ending card.
strings.act.incursion.text.1: In the future, a pivotal battle for the fate of the world has been lost.
strings.act.incursion.text.2: By harnessing the powers of the legendary Pokémon Dialga and Palkia, Team Galactic have travelled to our own time to shatter the Heart of Sinnoh, a primordial jewel that embodies the spirit of the world.
strings.act.incursion.text.3: To prevent retribution whilst their plans are finalised, grunts have been dispatched to subdue the villages of the region.
strings.act.incursion.text.4: Place one “Team Galactic Grunts” token on the home village of each trainer face-up. You cannot fly to or from a village with this token on. Draw the Act I card.
strings.act.journey.text.1: Members of your village are hesitant to make a stand against Team Galactic. Set out on a journey to catch and train a small team capable of liberating your home.
strings.act.journey.text.2: As you leave, you grab 3 Red Apricorns to construct some Poké Balls with.
strings.act.journey.text.3: Objective: Defeat the 2 Team Galactic Grunts at your home village.
strings.act.journey.text.5: Once one trainer completes this objective: Draw the Act II card and flip over the tokens at each of the three lakes.
strings.act.shards.text.1: The Shards needed to restore the Heart are bestowed by the three mysterious Lake Guardians.
strings.act.shards.text.2: Knowing this, Team Galactic have deployed their commanders to Lake Verity, Lake Acuity and Lake Valor to prevent anyone from collecting these Shards.
strings.act.shards.text.3: Objective: Defeat the Galactic Commanders at each lake to collect all three Shards.
strings.act.shards.text.5: Once one trainer completes this objective: Draw the Act III card and flip over the token at the Temple of Sinnoh.

strings.screen.room.menu.leave.note: Rejoin from this device to return to your seat.

strings.shrine_event.splendid_banquet.text.1: 4+ trainers: Choose another trainer to also get this effect
strings.shrine_event.splendid_banquet.text.2: Use 1/2/3 Apricorn Stew effects for free this turn. You cannot choose the same stew effect more than once.
strings.shrine_event.tranquil_moment.text.1: 4+ trainers: Choose another trainer to also get this effect
strings.shrine_event.unexpected_gift.text.1: 4+ trainers: Choose another trainer to also get this effect
strings.shrine_event.visitor_from_afar.text.1: All trainers gain 2 Green Apricorns. Place the Celebi token on the Timeless Shrine.
strings.stamp.1.text: You fail to capture a wild Pokémon 2 turns in a row during a battle.
strings.stamp.2.text: You win a battle against another trainer or an Ultra Beast.
strings.stamp.3.text: You have at least 1 of every Apricorn type in your bag.
strings.stamp.4.text: You have captured a Legendary Pokémon.
strings.stamp.5.text: You have 3 or more held items equipped in your party.
strings.stamp.6.text: You have been victorious at a Swarm Battle.
strings.stamp.7.text: You have 3 different Change of Fate cards in your hand.
strings.trainer_ability.ace_trainer.1.short: Retry 1 search per encounter; cheap Battle Items
strings.trainer_ability.ace_trainer.1.text: You may retry a Pokédex search once per encounter. Additionally, Battle Items only need 1 of each Apricorn on the recipe to craft.
strings.trainer_ability.aroma_lady.1.short: Apricorn Tree captures: 1 status → regular hit
strings.trainer_ability.aroma_lady.1.text: During capture attempts at Apricorn Trees, replace 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit.
strings.trainer_ability.aroma_lady.2.short: Grass/Fairy attacks heal half the damage dealt.
strings.trainer_ability.aroma_lady.2.text: When you attack with a Grass-type or Fairy-type move, the user heals for half the damage dealt, rounded up.
strings.trainer_ability.artist.1.short: Teach a defeated wild Pokémon's move to anyone.
strings.trainer_ability.artist.1.text: After defeating a wild Pokémon, you may teach its move to any Pokémon in your party regardless of their learnable move types.
strings.trainer_ability.artist.2.short: Every move type in party: all moves +2 power.
strings.trainer_ability.artist.2.text: If your party has a move of every type, all your moves gain +2 attack strength. Typeless moves and abilities act as wildcards and can be considered as any type towards achieving this effect.
strings.trainer_ability.backpacker.1.short: After any battle, fully heal 1 party Pokémon.
strings.trainer_ability.backpacker.1.text: After any battle, fully restore a Pokémon in your party.
strings.trainer_ability.backpacker.2.short: Pokémon can hold 2 different Held Items.
strings.trainer_ability.backpacker.2.text: Your Pokémon can now hold and use up to two Held Items so long as they are not the same item.
strings.trainer_ability.beauty.1.text: During all your rolls, critical hits deal +2 damage but status symbols deal -1 damage.
strings.trainer_ability.beauty.2.text: When you attack with a Normal-type or Dark-type move, status symbols deal +1 damage.
strings.trainer_ability.bird_keeper.1.short: Fly to a village from anywhere for 1 Apricorn.
strings.trainer_ability.bird_keeper.1.text: You may fly to a village from any tile by discarding 1 Apricorn. There cannot be any Team Galactic Grunts on the target village.
strings.trainer_ability.bird_keeper.2.short: Flying types ignore attacks of 2 damage or less
strings.trainer_ability.bird_keeper.2.text: Your Flying-type Pokémon take no damage from attacks that would only deal 2 or less damage to them.
strings.trainer_ability.black_belt.1.short: Defeat a wild Pokémon: +2 Journey Points.
strings.trainer_ability.black_belt.1.text: After defeating a wild Pokémon, gain 2 extra Journey Points.
strings.trainer_ability.black_belt.2.short: Burn your Pokémon; burned Fighting types +2.
strings.trainer_ability.black_belt.2.text: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may inflict the Burned status on your Pokémon. Replace the effect of Burned when applied to your Fighting-type Pokémon: Increase the total damage you deal by 2.
strings.trainer_ability.bug_catcher.1.short: Catch a Bug type: +2 JP and an extra turn.
strings.trainer_ability.bug_catcher.1.text: After capturing a Bug-type Pokémon, gain 2 extra Journey Points and immediately start an extra turn. Cannot be repeated on the extra turn.
strings.trainer_ability.bug_catcher.2.short: Bug types: +2 Initiative, Bug moves +1 power.
strings.trainer_ability.bug_catcher.2.text: Your Bug-type Pokémon gain +2 initiative and +1 attack strength to their Bug-type moves.
strings.trainer_ability.chef.1.short: Swap bag Apricorns for others of the same tier.
strings.trainer_ability.chef.1.text: You may freely convert the Apricorns in your bag for different Apricorns of the same tier.
strings.trainer_ability.chef.2.short: 1 of each Apricorn: same-type moves +1 power.
strings.trainer_ability.chef.2.text: Costs 1 of every Apricorn: Your Pokémon gain +1 attack strength to their moves that are the same type as them. Lasts until the end of battle.
strings.trainer_ability.collector.1.text: When claiming any stamp reward, you may claim the reward twice.
strings.trainer_ability.collector.2.short: Take stamp reward moves as Pokémon instead.
strings.trainer_ability.collector.2.text: The moves gained from stamp rewards can be added to your party as Pokémon instead. Additionally, when you discard any Pokémon or moves, add them to your stamp rewards move pool.
strings.trainer_ability.delinquent.1.short: Gain the Apricorns others offer at Shrines.
strings.trainer_ability.delinquent.1.text: When another trainer makes a Shrine Offering, gain the Apricorn they discard.
strings.trainer_ability.delinquent.2.short: Dark and Poison types take 2 less damage.
strings.trainer_ability.delinquent.2.text: Your Dark-type Pokémon and Poison-type Pokémon take 2 less damage from attacks.
strings.trainer_ability.diamond_acolyte.1.short: Follow Dialga; your token counts as 2 cards.
strings.trainer_ability.diamond_acolyte.1.text: When unlocked, become a Follower of Dialga for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Dialga's Play 3 effect.
strings.trainer_ability.diamond_acolyte.2.short: Get Dialga; weaker for each missing Shard.
strings.trainer_ability.diamond_acolyte.2.text: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Dialga and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Dialga by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.
strings.trainer_ability.dragon_tamer.1.short: Get a Weak Dragon type holding Apex Dragon.
strings.trainer_ability.dragon_tamer.1.text: When unlocked, search the Weak Pokémon deck for a Dragon-type Pokémon and add it to your party. This Pokémon receives the Apex Dragon held item which cannot be unequipped. Your Apex Dragon costs an extra 5 Journey Points to evolve at all stages.
strings.trainer_ability.dragon_tamer.2.text: Your Apex Dragon now gains +6 health, +2 initiative and +1 attack strength to its moves.
strings.trainer_ability.essentia.1.short: After a battle, use your leftover movement.
strings.trainer_ability.essentia.1.text: After a battle, you may use any movement you have remaining but cannot interact with anything else this turn.
strings.trainer_ability.essentia.2.short: Not moved yet: first wild attack deals double.
strings.trainer_ability.essentia.2.text: When you start a battle against a wild Pokémon, if you have not moved anywhere yet this turn, your first attack against them deals double damage.
strings.trainer_ability.expert.1.short: Shrine Offerings draw 1 extra card to choose.
strings.trainer_ability.expert.1.text: When you make a Shrine Offering, draw 1 extra Shrine Event card. This only gives you more choices, you still play the same number of Shrine Event cards as you would normally.
strings.trainer_ability.expert.2.short: Beast Boost: Legendaries heal 3, reset fatigue.
strings.trainer_ability.expert.2.text: When Beast Boost triggers, your Legendary Pokémon heal 3 damage, reset their battle fatigue to 0 and increase the attack strength of their next attack by 2.
strings.trainer_ability.fairy_tale_girl.1.short: Your Pokémon heal 1 extra whenever healed.
strings.trainer_ability.fairy_tale_girl.1.text: Your Pokémon heal 1 extra damage whenever they are healed by any effect.
strings.trainer_ability.fairy_tale_girl.2.short: Make your Pokémon drowsy; drowsy Fairies heal.
strings.trainer_ability.fairy_tale_girl.2.text: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may inflict the Drowsy status on your Pokémon. Replace the effect of Drowsy when applied to your Fairy-type Pokémon: At the end of your turns during battle, heal 1 damage.
strings.trainer_ability.fisherman.1.short: Reef captures: 1 status → hit; roll Catch Size.
strings.trainer_ability.fisherman.1.text: During capture attempts at Apricorn Reefs, replace 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit. After capturing a wild Pokémon at an Apricorn Reef, roll and then add a Catch Size dice to them.
strings.trainer_ability.fisherman.2.short: Health + Catch Size; 2 JP raises Catch Size.
strings.trainer_ability.fisherman.2.text: Your Pokémon now gain health equal to their Catch Size. Additionally, for the cost of 2 Journey Points: Increase the Catch Size of a Pokémon in your party to its next level.
strings.trainer_ability.gardener.1.short: Once per turn, take 1 Apricorn from your tree.
strings.trainer_ability.gardener.1.text: Once per turn, you may gain 1 Apricorn from an Apricorn Tree you are standing on.
strings.trainer_ability.gardener.2.short: Grass and Rock types: +3 Initiative, −2 Health.
strings.trainer_ability.gardener.2.text: Your Grass-type Pokémon and Rock-type Pokémon gain +3 initiative but -2 health.
strings.trainer_ability.gentleman.1.short: Double Apricorns from wild captures and wins.
strings.trainer_ability.gentleman.1.text: After capturing or defeating a wild Pokémon, gain double the amount of Apricorns.
strings.trainer_ability.gentleman.2.short: Get the Cherish Ball: it always catches.
strings.trainer_ability.gentleman.2.text: When unlocked, you receive the Cherish Ball. When the Cherish Ball is used to capture a wild Pokémon, it automatically captures that Pokémon. Additionally, if you release the captured Pokémon, you get the Cherish Ball back.
strings.trainer_ability.ginkgo_merchant.1.short: Gain the Apricorns others pay in Ginkgo Trades.
strings.trainer_ability.ginkgo_merchant.1.text: When another trainer uses the current Ginkgo Trade, gain the Apricorns they discard.
strings.trainer_ability.ginkgo_merchant.2.short: Pay 1 Apricorn: a move's base power is 4/5/6.
strings.trainer_ability.ginkgo_merchant.2.text: Before attacking, you may discard 1 Apricorn to temporarily change the base attack strength of a move this turn to 4/5/6 based on the tier of the Apricorn used. For example, 1 Black Apricorn would be required to change the attack strength of a move to 6.
strings.trainer_ability.guitarist.1.short: Get the Amp die: status symbols charge it.
strings.trainer_ability.guitarist.1.text: When unlocked, you receive an Amplifier dice. For every status symbol you roll, increase your Amplifier dice by 1. You may reset the Amplifier dice to add its value as damage to any attack. Your Amplifier dice value persists between battles.
strings.trainer_ability.guitarist.2.short: Electric attacks may double the Amp die once.
strings.trainer_ability.guitarist.2.text: When you attack with an Electric-type move, you may double the value of your Amplifier dice when its used. Afterwards, you can no longer use your Amplifier dice during this battle.
strings.trainer_ability.hex_maniac.1.short: Roll the status die to pick the status inflicted
strings.trainer_ability.hex_maniac.1.text: When inflicting any status effects, you may instead roll the status dice to inflict the new status effect it lands on.
strings.trainer_ability.hex_maniac.2.short: Stack new statuses; Ghost moves +1 power.
strings.trainer_ability.hex_maniac.2.text: You may inflict additional status effects onto a target so long as the target does not have that status effect already. Additionally, your Ghost-type moves gain +1 attack strength.
strings.trainer_ability.hiker.1.text: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Mountain tiles in a row for free. Additionally, you can move onto any tile regardless of its elevation.
strings.trainer_ability.hiker.2.short: Rock and Ground types: +4 Health, −1 Initiative
strings.trainer_ability.hiker.2.text: Your Rock-type Pokémon and Ground-type Pokémon gain +4 health but -1 initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.interviewers.1.short: When others get a stamp, battle them to win it.
strings.trainer_ability.interviewers.1.text: Whenever another trainer gains a Journey Stamp, you may instantly move to that trainer to challenge them to a battle. If you win the battle, you may also gain that Journey Stamp.
strings.trainer_ability.interviewers.2.short: Swap taught moves between your Pokémon.
strings.trainer_ability.interviewers.2.text: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may swap your taught moves between the Pokémon in your party. The Pokémon you give the move to must be able to learn it.
strings.trainer_ability.kindler.1.short: Remove an Apricorn Tree for 3 Firewood.
strings.trainer_ability.kindler.1.text: Once per turn, you may remove any Apricorn Tree from the map to add 3 Burned status effects to your bag as Firewood.
strings.trainer_ability.kindler.2.short: Fire attacks: 1 Firewood burns and deals +2.
strings.trainer_ability.kindler.2.text: When you attack with a Fire-type move, you may inflict the Burned status effect and deal 2 damage to the opposing Pokémon by using 1 Firewood from your bag.
strings.trainer_ability.lady.1.short: Gain 7 JP; Evolve Costs are 2 less.
strings.trainer_ability.lady.1.text: When unlocked, gain 7 Journey Points. Additionally, the Evolve Costs of your Pokémon are reduced by 2.
strings.trainer_ability.lady.2.short: Once per battle, fully heal a party Pokémon.
strings.trainer_ability.lady.2.text: Once per battle, heal all damage and status effects from a non-fainted Pokémon in your party.
strings.trainer_ability.ninja_boy.1.short: Initiative Advantage always lets you go first.
strings.trainer_ability.ninja_boy.1.text: When you have Initiative Advantage, you may use it to go first regardless of actual initiative values.
strings.trainer_ability.ninja_boy.2.short: Using Initiative Advantage inflicts a status.
strings.trainer_ability.ninja_boy.2.text: Inflict either the Poisoned, Confused or Drowsy status effects on the opposing Pokémon whenever you use Initiative Advantage.
strings.trainer_ability.parasol_lady.1.short: Set the Weather; matching moves +2 power.
strings.trainer_ability.parasol_lady.1.text: When unlocked, place the Weather Wheel in the middle of the arena on a Weather of your choice. Any trainer may change the Weather by discarding 3 Journey Points at a Shrine. All moves that match the Weather type gain +2 attack strength.
strings.trainer_ability.parasol_lady.2.short: Take 2 less damage from Weather-type moves.
strings.trainer_ability.parasol_lady.2.text: Your Pokémon take 2 less damage from moves that match the current Weather.
strings.trainer_ability.pearl_acolyte.1.short: Follow Palkia; your token counts as 2 cards.
strings.trainer_ability.pearl_acolyte.1.text: When unlocked, become a Follower of Palkia for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Palkia's Play 3 effect.
strings.trainer_ability.pearl_acolyte.2.short: Get Palkia; weaker for each missing Shard.
strings.trainer_ability.pearl_acolyte.2.text: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Palkia and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Palkia by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.
strings.trainer_ability.picnicker.1.short: 2 free Forest tiles; fly to Campsites.
strings.trainer_ability.picnicker.1.text: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Forest tiles in a row for free. Additionally, you may fly to Campsites from any tile by discarding 1 Apricorn.
strings.trainer_ability.picnicker.2.short: Crafting a stew gives another stew free.
strings.trainer_ability.picnicker.2.text: When crafting an Apricorn Stew, you may gain the effect of another Apricorn Stew for free.
strings.trainer_ability.platinum_acolyte.1.short: Follow Giratina; your token counts as 2 cards.
strings.trainer_ability.platinum_acolyte.1.text: When unlocked, become a Follower of Giratina for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Giratina's Play 3 effect.
strings.trainer_ability.platinum_acolyte.2.short: Get Giratina; weaker for each missing Shard.
strings.trainer_ability.platinum_acolyte.2.text: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Giratina and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Giratina by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_fan.1.short: Weak Pokémon take at most 3 damage per attack.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_fan.1.text: Your Weak Pokémon can at most take 3 damage from a single attack.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_fan.2.short: Crafting a Battle Item gives another free.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_fan.2.text: When crafting a Battle Item, you may gain another Battle Item for free.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_maniac.1.short: Attack with the foe's signature move.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_maniac.1.text: When attacking, you may use the signature move of the opposing Pokémon against them.
strings.trainer_ability.poke_maniac.2.short: Get Substitute: its holder switches in to block
strings.trainer_ability.poke_maniac.2.text: When unlocked, you receive the Substitute held item. The Pokémon with the Substitute held item attached may be switched in from your party just before any damage is applied from an opposing attack.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_breeder.1.short: Teach a Weak Pokémon its evolution's Egg Move.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_breeder.1.text: When evolving a Weak Pokémon, you may instead teach the move of its evolution to the pre-evolution as an Egg Move. This Pokémon can no longer evolve.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_breeder.2.text: Your Pokémon that were taught an Egg Move gain +5 health and +5 initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_ranger.1.short: Store Pokémon in locked party slots.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_ranger.1.text: You may use any locked party slots to store your Pokémon but these Pokémon cannot be used in battle. In the Ultra Burst campaign, you may store up to 2 Distortion Breach cards in each empty slot.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_ranger.2.short: Moderate Pokémon grow with each opened slot.
strings.trainer_ability.pokemon_ranger.2.text: Your Moderate Pokémon gain +1 health and +1 initiative for each locked party slot that you unlock. In the Ultra Burst campaign, you get the maximum of +3 health and +3 initiative immediately.
strings.trainer_ability.psychic.1.short: Interact with things up to 2 tiles away.
strings.trainer_ability.psychic.1.text: Once per turn, you may interact with something from up to 2 tiles away.
strings.trainer_ability.psychic.2.short: Psychic/Ghost attacks: set 1 die to any face.
strings.trainer_ability.psychic.2.text: When you attack with a Psychic-type or Ghost-type move, you may change the result of 1 dice rolled to any other value.
strings.trainer_ability.roller_skater.1.short: 2 free Plains tiles; wild Pokémon flee later.
strings.trainer_ability.roller_skater.1.text: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Plains tiles in a row for free. Additionally, non-Legendary wild Pokémon can now only flee after defeating two of your Pokémon.
strings.trainer_ability.roller_skater.2.short: Your Pokémon take at most 6 damage per attack.
strings.trainer_ability.roller_skater.2.text: Your Pokémon can at most take 6 damage from a single attack.
strings.trainer_ability.ruin_maniac.1.text: Once per turn, you may reveal 1 Special Hidden Spot anywhere on the map. If it is an Artifact, you may instantly move to it and attach it to a Pokémon in your party.
strings.trainer_ability.ruin_maniac.2.short: Artifacts +1 power and can't be taken.
strings.trainer_ability.ruin_maniac.2.text: Your Artifacts gain +1 attack strength to their bonuses and cannot be taken by other trainers.
strings.trainer_ability.scientist.1.short: Search without battling; teach the moves found.
strings.trainer_ability.scientist.1.text: Once per turn, search at an Apricorn Tree, Apricorn Reef or Distortion Gate without starting a battle. You may now directly teach all the moves searched to any Pokémon in your party that can learn them.
strings.trainer_ability.scientist.2.text: When attacking, your damage from positive type effectiveness is increased by 1.
strings.trainer_ability.scuba_diver.1.short: On Ocean, draw a discarded Hidden Spot.
strings.trainer_ability.scuba_diver.1.text: Once per turn whilst on an Ocean tile, shuffle the Hidden Spot discard pile and then draw the top Hidden Spot. Place the drawn Hidden Spot on the tile you are on, you may then interact with it as usual.
strings.trainer_ability.scuba_diver.2.short: After a Water attack, switch out and cure all.
strings.trainer_ability.scuba_diver.2.text: After you attack with a Water-type move, the user may switch out and then heal all status effects.
strings.trainer_ability.sky_trainer.1.short: Glide down 2+ levels, then 4 tiles free.
strings.trainer_ability.sky_trainer.1.text: You may move to adjacent tiles that are 2 or more elevations lower than your current tile. After doing so, you may move up to 4 additional tiles in a row so long as your elevation does not increase.
strings.trainer_ability.sky_trainer.2.short: Flying types +1 power vs non-Flying foes.
strings.trainer_ability.sky_trainer.2.text: Your Flying-type Pokémon gain +1 attack strength to all their moves so long as they are not against another Flying-type Pokémon.
strings.trainer_ability.swimmer.1.short: 2 free Ocean tiles; Water types +1 Initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.swimmer.1.text: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Ocean tiles in a row for free. Additionally, your Water-type Pokémon gain +1 initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.swimmer.2.short: Water attacks may count as Bug or Flying.
strings.trainer_ability.swimmer.2.text: When you attack with a Water-type move, you may change its type to either Bug-type or Flying-type.
strings.trainer_ability.team_aqua.1.short: End on Ocean: jump to any Ocean tile.
strings.trainer_ability.team_aqua.1.text: If you are standing on an Ocean tile at the end of your turn, you may instantly move to any other Ocean tile.
strings.trainer_ability.team_aqua.2.short: Water moves +1 power; Water types take 1 less.
strings.trainer_ability.team_aqua.2.text: During your battles, all Water-type moves gain +1 attack strength and all Water-type Pokémon take 1 less damage when attacked.
strings.trainer_ability.team_magma.1.short: End on a Mountain: jump to any Mountain tile.
strings.trainer_ability.team_magma.1.text: If you are standing on a Mountain tile at the end of your turn, you may instantly move to any other Mountain tile.
strings.trainer_ability.team_magma.2.short: Fire moves +1 power; Fire types take 1 less.
strings.trainer_ability.team_magma.2.text: During your battles, all Fire-type moves gain +1 attack strength and all Fire-type Pokémon take 1 less damage when attacked.
strings.trainer_ability.team_rocket.1.text: During a battle with another trainer, you can attempt to capture their Pokémon but with -2 to your capture rolls. The captured Pokémon keeps everything it currently has attached.
strings.trainer_ability.team_rocket.2.short: Fainting deals 2; blast off to any tile.
strings.trainer_ability.team_rocket.2.text: When one of your Pokémon faints, deal 2 damage to the opposing Pokémon. If you are out of usable Pokémon, you may travel to any tile on the map and are automatically fully restored at the start of your next turn.
strings.trainer_ability.tourist.1.short: Get the Landmark Tour sheet for Legendary Snaps
strings.trainer_ability.tourist.1.text: When unlocked, place the Landmark Tour sheet in your hand. Once at each Artifact Legendary Location, stamp it on your Landmark Tour sheet to search for the Legendary Pokémon there and make a clone of its card. These cards become your Legendary Snaps and are kept next to your trainer area.
strings.trainer_ability.tourist.2.short: Teach Legendary Snaps; full tour gives 30 JP.
strings.trainer_ability.tourist.2.text: You may teach the Legendary Snaps you have collected as moves to any Pokémon in your party that can learn them. Additionally, if you complete your Landmark Tour sheet, gain 30 Journey Points.
strings.trainer_ability.triathlete.1.text: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 non-Mountain tiles in a row for free.
strings.trainer_ability.triathlete.2.short: Attack as any of your 3 move types.
strings.trainer_ability.triathlete.2.text: When your Pokémon knows moves of 3 different types, you may change the type of your attack to any of those 3 types. Works for Typeless moves too.
strings.trainer_ability.undivided_acolyte.1.shor: Follow Arceus: counts as all three Gods.
strings.trainer_ability.undivided_acolyte.1.text: When unlocked, replace your Follower token with the Follower of Arceus token for the rest of the game. A Follower of Arceus is counted as a Follower of all three Gods of Sinnoh at the same time.
strings.trainer_ability.undivided_acolyte.2.shor: Foes left with 2 Health or less faint.
strings.trainer_ability.undivided_acolyte.2.text: After attacking, the opposing Pokémon faints if they have 2 or less health remaining.
strings.trainer_ability.veteran.1.short: Apricorn Stash: +2 Apricorns and +1 tile move.
strings.trainer_ability.veteran.1.text: When you find an Apricorn Stash, gain 2 extra Apricorns of the same type and move 1 additional tile this turn.
strings.trainer_ability.veteran.2.short: Ice/Dragon attacks may add 2 status symbols.
strings.trainer_ability.veteran.2.text: When you attack with an Ice-type or Dragon-type move, you may add up to 2 status symbols to roll.
strings.trainer_ability.worker.1.short: Pay 2 JP to build Roads where you walk.
strings.trainer_ability.worker.1.text: Costs 2 Journey Points: You may build Roads on any non-Ocean tiles you move onto this turn. All trainers can move through any number of interconnected Roads for 1 tile move. Roads are built by drawing them with the Pen tool.
strings.trainer_ability.worker.2.short: Steel switch-in: foe +3 fatigue, can't escape.
strings.trainer_ability.worker.2.text: When your Steel-type Pokémon are switched in, increase the battle fatigue of the opposing Pokémon by 3 and prevent them from switching out or fleeing the battle.
strings.trainer_ability.youngster.1.short: Weak Pokémon get +1 Health and +1 Initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.youngster.1.text: Your Weak Pokémon gain +1 health and +1 initiative.
strings.trainer_ability.youngster.2.short: Draw 5 trainer cards and swap to one.
strings.trainer_ability.youngster.2.text: When unlocked, draw 5 trainer cards from the deck and swap this card with one of the drawn cards. Triggers the "when unlocked" effects on the new trainer card.
strings.tutorial.e01.S001: This time, let's learn about Change of Fate cards.
strings.tutorial.e01.S002: You hold 6 Change of Fate cards. For every 4 Fallen Stars, everyone draws 1.
strings.tutorial.e01.S003: But your hand holds 5 at most. At 6, you must discard 1 right away.
strings.tutorial.e01.S004: [Discard] one Arceus to get back down to 5. You may also discard the card you just drew.
strings.tutorial.e01.S005: Excellent! Holding 3 different Fate cards earned you 1 Journey Stamp!
strings.tutorial.e01.S006: Outside battle, you may play Fate cards once on your turn. Press [Change of Fate] to open your hand.
strings.tutorial.e01.S007: Palkia's [Play 1] teleports you up to 3 tiles, whatever the height. Let's go to that tree.
strings.tutorial.e01.S007.hint: Pick Palkia, press [Play 1], then pick the tree tile.
strings.tutorial.e01.S008: Teleporting uses no movement, so you still have 3. Close your hand and [Search].
strings.tutorial.e01.S009: Pick Drifloon and battle it. In battle, you may play Fate cards once on each turn.
strings.tutorial.e01.S010: Drifloon is faster and moves first. When the Fate window opens, press [Pass] for now.
strings.tutorial.e01.S011: You can play Dialga on your foe's roll too. But it all missed, so [Pass].
strings.tutorial.e01.S012: Now it's our turn. Choose a move.
strings.tutorial.e01.S013: Giratina is played before rolling. Save it with [Pass], and we'll roll at Power 3.
strings.tutorial.e01.S014: Two missed! Two Dialga plus an Arceus make [Play 3]. Reroll them, and you keep 1 card.
strings.tutorial.e01.S014.hint: Pick the two missed dice, then Dialga's [Play 3].
strings.tutorial.e01.S015: Oh, a critical hit! In a 3-card effect, Arceus counts as any 1 card. Now, [Pass].
strings.tutorial.e01.S016: Drifloon attacks. Piplup has 3 Health left. [Pass] here too.
strings.tutorial.e01.S017: Our turn again. Choose a move.
strings.tutorial.e01.S018: Giratina [Play 1]! Piplup takes 2 damage, but Power becomes 4. Health is now 1.
strings.tutorial.e01.S019: Well done! Round 2 began, and a Fallen Star gave you 1 card: 1 in hand.
strings.tutorial.e01.S020: Even if Giratina drops you to 0 Health, the move still goes off. See the tooltips for details.
strings.tutorial.e02.S001: This time, let's learn more about [Craft].
strings.tutorial.e02.S002: You have 3 Apricorns of each color and 20 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e02.S003: Press [Craft] to see what you can make.
strings.tutorial.e02.S004: There are four balls. Better balls roll more capture dice, so they catch more easily.
strings.tutorial.e02.S005: There are four stews too, and they work at once. Each stew can be made once per turn.
strings.tutorial.e02.S006: Let's make a Zesty Stew. It adds 3 movement, so you have 6 this turn.
strings.tutorial.e02.S007: Excellent! All seven colors earned 1 Journey Stamp, plus a Red, Blue and Yellow Apricorn!
strings.tutorial.e02.S008: There are six held items. They take effect in battle while a Pokémon holds them.
strings.tutorial.e02.S009: Let's make a Star Shield. It costs 3 Blue Apricorns, leaving 1 Blue.
strings.tutorial.e02.S010: Crafted held items go into your bag. Close the crafting window and press [Manage].
strings.tutorial.e02.S011: Drag the Star Shield from your bag onto Piplup's held item slot.
strings.tutorial.e02.S011.hint: Move the Star Shield onto Piplup.
strings.tutorial.e02.S012: Good! Giving items is part of managing, so change them anytime outside battle. See the tooltips.
strings.tutorial.e03.S001: This time, let's learn about the Ginkgo Merchants and Fly.
strings.tutorial.e03.S002: You're in Eterna Village now, with 3 Apricorns of each color.
strings.tutorial.e03.S003: Press [Village] to see what you can do here.
strings.tutorial.e03.S004: A Ginkgo card has 2 trade rows. Give the Apricorns on the left, get the ones on the right.
strings.tutorial.e03.S005: You can trade one row or both. Press [Both rows], and you'll have 4 Black.
strings.tutorial.e03.S006: You may trade once per turn. Afterward, the deck is shuffled and a new card comes to the top.
strings.tutorial.e03.S007: Excellent! All seven colors earned 1 Journey Stamp, plus a Red, Blue and Yellow Apricorn!
strings.tutorial.e03.S008: [Fly] takes any 1 Apricorn to another village. Neither village may have Grunts.
strings.tutorial.e03.S009: Grunts hold Canalave, your home. Pay a Red Apricorn to fly to Celestic Village; 2 Red remain.
strings.tutorial.e03.S009.hint: Pick Celestic Village and a Red Apricorn, then press [Take off].
strings.tutorial.e03.S010: Close the window. Flying uses no movement, so you still have 3. You can't fly to a campsite.
strings.tutorial.e04.S001: This time, let's learn about evolution.
strings.tutorial.e04.S002: Eevee is in your party, and you have 20 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e04.S003: On your turn outside battle, evolving costs its Evolve Cost in Journey Points. Eevee's is 8.
strings.tutorial.e04.S004: First, press [Craft]. An Infused Stew can lower the cost.
strings.tutorial.e04.S005: Make an Infused Stew, and one evolution this turn costs only half the Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e04.S006: Close the crafting window and press [Evolve] to see who can evolve.
strings.tutorial.e04.S007: Turn on [Infused Stew: half price], then press [Evolve] on Eevee.
strings.tutorial.e04.S007.hint: Turn on [Infused Stew: half price], then press [Evolve] on Eevee.
strings.tutorial.e04.S008: Eevee can evolve in many ways! Pick Leafeon. At half price, 16 points remain.
strings.tutorial.e04.S009: Oh, Leafeon! You may also teach its old signature move, Quick Attack. Put it in the first slot.
strings.tutorial.e04.S010: Evolving heals fully. Close the window: Leafeon has 8 Health. Held items and moves stay too.
strings.tutorial.e05.S001: This time, let's learn about hidden spots.
strings.tutorial.e05.S002: Face-down tokens are hidden spots. You may reveal one when you pass or stop on its tile.
strings.tutorial.e05.S003: There are five results: Apricorn stash, campsite, Fallen Star, artifact and Alpha Pokémon.
strings.tutorial.e05.S004: You never know what you'll find, so let's [Craft] a Poké Ball first.
strings.tutorial.e05.S006: Close the crafting window and step onto the token on the mountain. 2 movement remains.
strings.tutorial.e05.S006.hint: Close the window and click the marked tile.
strings.tutorial.e05.S007: Press [Reveal]. Once revealed, you must follow its effect.
strings.tutorial.e05.S008: Oh, the Seafarer Egg artifact! Revealed artifacts go into your bag.
strings.tutorial.e05.S009: An artifact only works while a Pokémon holds it. Press [Manage] to open your party.
strings.tutorial.e05.S010: Give it to Piplup. The Seafarer Egg adds 1 Power to Psychic and Water moves.
strings.tutorial.e05.S010.hint: Move the Seafarer Egg onto Piplup.
strings.tutorial.e05.S011: Close the window and head for the token on the plains. 1 movement remains.
strings.tutorial.e05.S011.hint: Close the window and click the marked tile.
strings.tutorial.e05.S012: [Reveal] this token too. Let's see what it is.
strings.tutorial.e05.S013: An Alpha Weavile! A revealed Alpha must be battled. It gains 4 Health and counts as Legendary.
strings.tutorial.e05.S014: It all missed. Thanks to the Egg, your Water move has Power 4. Attack!
strings.tutorial.e05.S015: An Alpha's capture rate is 6. Throw the Poké Ball!
strings.tutorial.e05.S016: Oh, you caught it! Caught or defeated, an Alpha gives 4 Journey Points. No Apricorns, though.
strings.tutorial.e05.S017: Catching the Alpha with a ball earned 1 Journey Stamp for a Legendary capture, plus its Apricorns.
strings.tutorial.e05.S018: Defeating it gives 2 more points. A caught Alpha keeps its token, so it can't hold other items.
strings.tutorial.e06.S001: This time, let's dig deeper into battles.
strings.tutorial.e06.S002: This time your party is Piplup and Eevee: 2 Pokémon. Let's take on the Grunts at home.
strings.tutorial.e06.S003: [Challenge] them. The challenger sends out first and gets the Initiative Advantage token.
strings.tutorial.e06.S004: Send out Piplup. Glameow is faster, so it will attack first.
strings.tutorial.e06.S005: It all missed. Now it's our turn. Attack with Power 3!
strings.tutorial.e06.S006: Glameow fainted, storing 2 damage in Galactic Retribution. Plan B stores 1 more each time.
strings.tutorial.e06.S007: When a foe faints, you may switch. Switch to Eevee: switching resets Fatigue to 0.
strings.tutorial.e06.S008: Fatigue fills after 5 rolls in a row. After that, every roll deals 3 damage to you.
strings.tutorial.e06.S009: Zubat and Eevee have the same Initiative. [Use] the token to move first; then it goes to the foe.
strings.tutorial.e06.S009.hint: Press [Use] on the Initiative Advantage token.
strings.tutorial.e06.S010: Attack with Eevee. Quick Attack has Power 2.
strings.tutorial.e06.S011: Quick Attack can strike once more this turn. This time, save it with [Pass].
strings.tutorial.e06.S012: Ouch! The 2 stored damage moved over, and Poison Fang poisoned Eevee. Health is 3.
strings.tutorial.e06.S013: A Poisoned Pokémon takes 2 damage at the end of each of its battle turns. Tooltips cover the rest.
strings.tutorial.e06.S014: Finish it! Defeat Zubat to win.
strings.tutorial.e06.S015: Well done! Driving out the Grunts opened Act 2, and you got 1 Journey Stamp.
strings.tutorial.e06.S016: Legendaries and Alphas have Alpha Strike and Beast Boost. See the tooltips for details.
strings.tutorial.e06.S017: You hold the Initiative Advantage token. The challenger gets it, and it only works on a tie.
strings.tutorial.e06.S018: On an Initiative tie, the token holder decides. If they don't use it, the other side moves first.
strings.tutorial.e06.S019: The used token went to Zubat's side. On the next tie, the foe decides.
strings.tutorial.e06.S020: Matchup adds up per type. Zubat is Poison/Flying, and Normal moves get 0 against both.
strings.tutorial.e07.S001: Shrines this time. Offer an Apricorn at a Shrine to draw Shrine Event cards.
strings.tutorial.e07.S003: You're standing at the Meadow Shrine with 9 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e07.S004: You may make one offering per turn. The Apricorn's color sets the card tier; Pink is tier 2.
strings.tutorial.e07.S005: Press [Offering] to open the Shrine window.
strings.tutorial.e07.S006: Pay 7 more Journey Points to draw 3 and keep 2. Offer Pink, and 2 points remain.
strings.tutorial.e07.S006.hint: Offer a Pink Apricorn plus 7 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e07.S007: Resolve them one at a time. First, A Song of Fire: everyone gains Red, giving you 5.
strings.tutorial.e07.S007.hint: Pick A Song of Fire and press [Confirm].
strings.tutorial.e07.S008: Look! Moltres appeared at the Firesong Shrine! [Search] on that tile to battle it.
strings.tutorial.e07.S009: While Moltres is at that Shrine, no one can make offerings there.
strings.tutorial.e07.S010: Next, Tranquil Moment. Tier 2 gives 4 Journey Points, so you have 6.
strings.tutorial.e07.S011: With 4 or more players, a Shrine Blessing card also gives its effect to 1 other trainer.
strings.tutorial.e07.S012: Legendary events aren't shared. The leftover card is discarded. That's all for Shrines!
strings.tutorial.e08.S001: Three of us this time, with Barry and Dawn. The topic is the Celestial Fracture.
strings.tutorial.e08.S002: Home villages were picked counterclockwise from you: Dawn, then Barry.
strings.tutorial.e08.S004: Starters and Trainer Cards are all picked in secret. This time, we start once everyone has chosen.
strings.tutorial.e08.S006: Everyone has chosen, so we begin. You start at the Meadow Shrine with 9 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e08.S007: Barry, who picked his village last, goes first. Others' turns show in the band up top.
strings.tutorial.e08.S009: Now it's your turn. Press [Offering] to open the Shrine window.
strings.tutorial.e08.S010: Offer 1 Pink Apricorn and draw 1 card.
strings.tutorial.e08.S011: Oh, a Celestial Fracture! Everyone drew 1 Change of Fate card.
strings.tutorial.e08.S012: Now everyone secretly chooses a God to follow. The first time, you may choose none.
strings.tutorial.e08.S013: This time, pick Palkia and press [Confirm].
strings.tutorial.e08.S015: Dawn is choosing too. Once all have chosen, the picks are revealed together.
strings.tutorial.e08.S016: Palkia has the most Followers. Palkia has descended to the Origin Shrine!
strings.tutorial.e08.S017: While the God you follow is at the Origin Shrine, you get +1 movement every turn.
strings.tutorial.e08.S021: See? You have 4 movement this turn, thanks to following Palkia.
strings.tutorial.e08.S022: [Search] on the God's tile to battle it. Without its Celestial Artifact, capture needs 7 or more.
strings.tutorial.e08.S023: Once you follow a God, you can't go back to none. That's all for the Fracture!
strings.tutorial.e09.S001: Journey Stamps this time. Meet a condition, and you get the stamp right away.
strings.tutorial.e09.S003: Your party has 3 Pokémon, and two of them already hold items.
strings.tutorial.e09.S004: Press [Stamps] to open the stamp sheet.
strings.tutorial.e09.S005: There are 7 conditions; see each one's tooltip. Any order, and once earned, a stamp stays.
strings.tutorial.e09.S006: Rewards come at once, by how many you have. The first gives 1 Red, Blue and Yellow Apricorn.
strings.tutorial.e09.S007: Let's earn "3 held items." Close the stamp sheet and press [Manage] to open your party.
strings.tutorial.e09.S008: Give the Lucky Egg in your bag to your starter.
strings.tutorial.e09.S008.hint: Give the Lucky Egg to your starter.
strings.tutorial.e09.S009: Oh, stamp number 1! Close the window. The reward brought your Red Apricorns to 4.
strings.tutorial.e09.S010: Collect all 7 to receive the Scroll of Nobility. That's all for stamps!
strings.tutorial.e10.S001: This time it's just you and Barry. Let's try trading and battling.
strings.tutorial.e10.S003: Villages, starters and Trainer Cards are each picked in secret. Barry has picked too.
strings.tutorial.e10.S005: First, Barry's turn. Watch others' turns in the band up top and in the log.
strings.tutorial.e10.S006: Your turn. Barry is on your tile. On the same tile, you can trade as you like.
strings.tutorial.e10.S007: Press [Trade] to open the trade window.
strings.tutorial.e10.S008: [Offer] a trade: give 1 Red Apricorn and get 1 Blue.
strings.tutorial.e10.S008.hint: Give 1 Red and ask for 1 Blue.
strings.tutorial.e10.S009: Once Barry accepts, the swap happens at once. Now you have 1 Blue.
strings.tutorial.e10.S010: Followers of the same God can trade from other tiles, even on others' turns.
strings.tutorial.e10.S011: Now, [Challenge]. On the same tile outside a village, Barry can't refuse.
strings.tutorial.e10.S012: A trainer battle! Choose who to send out.
strings.tutorial.e10.S014: In battle, your opponent can also choose to play Change of Fate.
strings.tutorial.e10.S015: You won! You take 1 artifact or 2 Fate cards from them. Take the Magma Stone.
strings.tutorial.e10.S016: Beating a trainer is a stamp condition too. You now have 1 stamp.
strings.tutorial.e10.S017: When the battle ends, so does your turn. That's all for challenges and trades!
strings.tutorial.e11.S001: Swarm Battles this time. [Search] at a Distortion Gate to start one.
strings.tutorial.e11.S003: This time I'll lend you Dialga. It's at the front of your party.
strings.tutorial.e11.S004: You're at the Deepmarsh Gate. Each gate has a set biome; this one is Forest.
strings.tutorial.e11.S005: [Search]. A Weak, a Moderate and a Strong Pokémon of that biome come out, in that order.
strings.tutorial.e11.S006: The wild side only flees after defeating all your Pokémon. Send out Dialga.
strings.tutorial.e11.S007: First, the Weak one. Attack with a move.
strings.tutorial.e11.S008: You may switch each time one falls. This time, press [Stay in].
strings.tutorial.e11.S009: Next, the Moderate one. Attack until it falls.
strings.tutorial.e11.S010: Last, the Strong one. Don't switch; attack to the end.
strings.tutorial.e11.S010.hint: Press [Stay in], then choose a move.
strings.tutorial.e11.S011: Oh, you beat all three! The reward is 7 Journey Points in all, plus 1 stamp.
strings.tutorial.e11.S012: Catching one also moves on. Lose, and you get no points, but you may teach moves of those you beat.
strings.tutorial.e11.S013: Gates guard no Apricorns, so there are none to get. That's all for Swarm Battles!
strings.tutorial.e12.S001: Trainer Cards this time. Each time the card ranks up, one ability unlocks.
strings.tutorial.e12.S003: Your Trainer Card this time is the Youngster. I'll lend you Palkia and Heatran, too.
strings.tutorial.e12.S004: This card is already Silver, tier 2. Beating or getting a Moderate Pokémon unlocked Blue.
strings.tutorial.e12.S005: This is a Strong tree. Defeat a Strong Pokémon to reach Gold and unlock Red too.
strings.tutorial.e12.S007: A Strong tree shows only 1 card. Pick that Pokémon.
strings.tutorial.e12.S009: Defeat it, and the card turns Gold, tier 3. Attack with a move.
strings.tutorial.e12.S010: Let's not teach the defeated Pokémon's move this time.
strings.tutorial.e12.S011: Gold! Red 'Career Options' unlocked. Swap to Kindler from the 5 cards drawn.
strings.tutorial.e12.S011.hint: Pick Kindler and press [Swap to this card].
strings.tutorial.e12.S012: The new card starts at Gold. Any 'When unlocked' effects trigger right away.
strings.tutorial.e12.S013: Press [Trainer Card] to look over the new card's two abilities.
strings.tutorial.e12.S014: Close the card window. Use [Gather Firewood] below to clear a nearby tree for 3 Firewood.
strings.tutorial.e12.S014.hint: Press [Gather Firewood], then pick the tree next to you.
strings.tutorial.e12.S015: [Search] again. This time, let's fight with Heatran.
strings.tutorial.e12.S018: On an Initiative tie, you're asked about the Initiative Advantage token. [Pass] this time.
strings.tutorial.e12.S020: Battle abilities ask in the moment. Red 'Burning Ignition' spends 1 Firewood: Burn and +2 damage.
strings.tutorial.e12.S021: Keep attacking. If it asks again, you may save your Firewood.
strings.tutorial.e12.S022: Well done! Some abilities are always on, so check the tooltips. That's all for Trainer Cards.
strings.tutorial.e13.S001: Ultra Burst this time. Beat all 3 of Necrozma's phases to win.
strings.tutorial.e13.S003: Villages, starters and Trainer Cards are each picked in secret. Barry has picked too.
strings.tutorial.e13.S005: You start with 3 each of 3 Apricorn colors and 6 party slots. Shared Blessings this time: 3.
strings.tutorial.e13.S006: Blessings are 3, 1 or 0 by difficulty. They skip a UB turn or revive an eliminated trainer.
strings.tutorial.e13.S007: Many trees here are already broken. Breach Strength is 9%; at 70%, everyone loses.
strings.tutorial.e13.S008: Nine Ultra Beasts are scattered about, and Necrozma waits at the heart of the Distortion World.
strings.tutorial.e13.S009: First, Barry's turn. After everyone has taken a turn, the Ultra Beasts take theirs.
strings.tutorial.e13.S010: Your turn. This time, press [End Turn] right away.
strings.tutorial.e13.S011: At round end, everyone votes on spending a Blessing to skip the UB turn. Choose [Skip].
strings.tutorial.e13.S012: Barry chose [Don't skip]. A tie isn't a majority, so there's no skip: still 3 Blessings.
strings.tutorial.e13.S013: The UBs moved 4 tiles, smashing trees, and Necrozma struck 1 spot. Breach: 13%.
strings.tutorial.e13.S014: Every 10% of Breach, UBs move 1 tile farther, and everyone gets a Distortion Breach card.
strings.tutorial.e13.S015: At turn start, you must attach that card to a move slot. [Attach] it to an empty one.
strings.tutorial.e13.S015.hint: Pick an empty move slot, then press [Attach].
strings.tutorial.e13.S016: Barry attaches his too. An attached card stays until you defeat an Ultra Beast.
strings.tutorial.e13.S017: We'll see how to fight Ultra Beasts in the next chapter. That's all for the board!
strings.tutorial.e14.S001: This time, let's battle Ultra Beasts and Necrozma. It's you and Barry.
strings.tutorial.e14.S003: Villages, starters and Trainer Cards are each picked in secret. Barry has picked too.
strings.tutorial.e14.S004: This time I'll lend you Togekiss and Dialga.
strings.tutorial.e14.S005: First, Barry's turn. Meanwhile, look at your tile: Pheromosa is here.
strings.tutorial.e14.S006: [Search] on a UB token's tile to battle it. Take on Pheromosa.
strings.tutorial.e14.S007: Ultra Beasts can't be captured. Send out Togekiss for the better matchup.
strings.tutorial.e14.S008: Ultra Onslaught is on in this game: each UB turn, 1 card is drawn and used at once. Attack.
strings.tutorial.e14.S009: Like a Legendary, a UB wins only by beating all your Pokémon. Send out Dialga.
strings.tutorial.e14.S010: Win for 6 Journey Points, and Necrozma's Prism Armour drops to 8. Attack.
strings.tutorial.e14.S011: The lost piece goes to the UB side. Every 2 pieces there cut its damage taken by 1 per turn.
strings.tutorial.e14.S012: The round-end question. This time, choose [Don't skip].
strings.tutorial.e14.S013: Barry chose [Don't skip] too. Now the UB turn runs.
strings.tutorial.e14.S014: The next round starts with Barry again.
strings.tutorial.e14.S015: Gates take you to their paired gate without using movement. Cross into the Distortion World.
strings.tutorial.e14.S016: Walk two tiles to Necrozma's tile at the center.
strings.tutorial.e14.S017: [Search] to challenge Necrozma. Phase 1 has 24 Health.
strings.tutorial.e14.S018: With 8 Prism Armour, Necrozma is tough. Fight it to the end with Dialga.
strings.tutorial.e14.S019: Lose to Necrozma, and you are eliminated: no turns, and no round-end question.
strings.tutorial.e14.S020: A Blessing can revive an eliminated trainer. Click the Blessing chip to open the window.
strings.tutorial.e14.S021: You may use it even on someone else's turn. Press [Revive].
strings.tutorial.e14.S022: Barry pressed [Allow], so you're back. Close the window. You heal at home; 2 Blessings remain.
strings.tutorial.e14.S023: When Barry ends his turn, it's your turn again.
strings.tutorial.e14.S024: Win a phase to move on to the next. A coin decides the phase 2 form. Win all three to win!
strings.tutorial.e15.S001: Lake trials this time. Until you pass its trial, a Guardian ignores damage and capture.
strings.tutorial.e15.S003: This time I'll lend you Palkia. It's at the front of your party.
strings.tutorial.e15.S004: This is Lake Valor Cavern: Azelf's Trial of Willpower. Land 2 critical hits within 2 turns.
strings.tutorial.e15.S007: It's an Initiative tie, so you're asked about the token. [Pass] this time.
strings.tutorial.e15.S008: Attack. Land 2 critical hits to pass the trial.
strings.tutorial.e15.S009: Trial passed! It stays immune through this turn, so damage lands from the next one.
strings.tutorial.e15.S010: Now your attacks get through. Attack!
strings.tutorial.e15.S011: Attack once more. Guardians are Legendary too, so a win gives 6 Journey Points.
strings.tutorial.e15.S012: Azelf is down! Each Guardian defeated or caught gives everyone +2 movement.
strings.tutorial.e15.S013: Solo games ask at round end too. Choose [Don't skip].
strings.tutorial.e15.S014: Your new turn's movement is 3 plus 2: 5.
strings.tutorial.e15.S015: Mesprit must take Fatigue damage; Uxie must be hit super effectively by two types.
strings.tutorial.e15.S016: Defeat or catch Silvally at the Temple of Sinnoh to gain 1 Blessing. That's all for trials!
strings.tutorial.main.S001: Hello there! Welcome to Sinnoh! My name is Rowan. Your first journey, is it? Then I shall guide you!
strings.tutorial.main.S002: This journey follows the Heart of Sinnoh story. It is told in acts, from the Prologue to the Finale.
strings.tutorial.main.S003: Each act has a goal. Reach it, and the next act opens.
strings.tutorial.main.S004: In the Finale, you choose to be the Hero or the Traitor. I'll explain that when we get there.
strings.tutorial.main.S005: Today we'll go as far as Act I together. Now, let's set up the game!
strings.tutorial.main.S101: First, choose your home village. Pick a row, and its place lights up on the board. Try Canalave.
strings.tutorial.main.S102: A Trainer Card is your job. Choose 1 of 3. Meet its conditions, and its abilities unlock.
strings.tutorial.main.S103: Your starter is your first partner. The starters you don't pick go into the Weak Pokémon deck.
strings.tutorial.main.S104: This time, pick Piplup and the Hiker card. Once both are chosen, press the button below.
strings.tutorial.main.S104.hint: Pick Piplup and the Hiker card.
strings.tutorial.main.S105: What's this? Team Galactic Grunts in your home village! The Prologue card brought them here.
strings.tutorial.main.S106: The Act I card gave you 3 Red Apricorns. Apricorns are what you craft balls from.
strings.tutorial.main.S107: Face-down tokens are hidden spots. When you pass one, you may choose whether to reveal it.
strings.tutorial.main.S201: Now, let's read the screen. Look at the top bar. It is round 1, Act 1.
strings.tutorial.main.S202: Below is your party. Only Piplup for now: 1 Pokémon. You gain slots as you travel.
strings.tutorial.main.S203: Your Apricorns, Journey Points and balls show here. You still have 0 balls.
strings.tutorial.main.S204: Press [Open] on the log to look back at what happened. Check it if you missed anything.
strings.tutorial.main.S205: Hover over a tile or card to see its info card. Check it whenever you're unsure.
strings.tutorial.main.S301: Now, your first turn! You have 3 movement. You can't step to a tile 2 or more levels apart.
strings.tutorial.main.S302: Take one step onto the Apricorn tree next to you. That leaves 2 movement.
strings.tutorial.main.S303: [Search] at a tree to draw 3 encounter cards. Then you pick 1 of them.
strings.tutorial.main.S304: A wild Shieldon! Pick this card and battle it.
strings.tutorial.main.S305: In battle, higher Initiative moves first. Piplup is faster, so we go first!
strings.tutorial.main.S306: Shieldon is Rock, so it's weak to Water. See the move: Power 3, matchup 2.
strings.tutorial.main.S307: Three critical hits made 6. Add the matchup, and the damage was 8. One hit did it.
strings.tutorial.main.S308: Well done! You earned 3 Journey Points and the tree's 3 Apricorns. When ready, press [OK].
strings.tutorial.main.S309: A battle ends your turn. It's already round 2, a new turn.
strings.tutorial.main.S310: An attack die has 6 faces: 4 regular hits worth 1, 1 critical hit worth 2, 1 status symbol worth 0.
strings.tutorial.main.S311: Damage is the dice total plus the matchup. When you attack, this line shows the sum.
strings.tutorial.main.S312: Matchup is +2 if strong, −2 if weak, −4 if it has no effect. Against two types, add both.
strings.tutorial.main.S401: This turn, let's catch a Pokémon. To catch one, you first need a ball.
strings.tutorial.main.S402: Press [Craft] to see what you can make.
strings.tutorial.main.S403: Let's make 1 Poké Ball. It takes just 1 Red Apricorn.
strings.tutorial.main.S404: Close the crafting window, then [Search] the same tree again.
strings.tutorial.main.S405: Bidoof is Weak tier, so it's easy to catch. Pick this card.
strings.tutorial.main.S406: Throw the Poké Ball! If its 3 dice total the capture rate 3 or more, it's caught.
strings.tutorial.main.S407: Oh, you caught it! A total of 4 beat the capture rate. Press [OK].
strings.tutorial.main.S408: A capture roll is still a roll, so it adds 1 Fatigue. Fatigue shows in the party slot.
strings.tutorial.main.S409: Capturing counts as a battle, so your turn ended. Now it's round 3.
strings.tutorial.main.S410: Each card shows its tier and capture rate: Weak 3, Moderate 4, Strong 5, Legendary 6.
strings.tutorial.main.S411: The foe's info shows its tier and capture rate too. Capture dice totaling that or more catch it.
strings.tutorial.main.S412: Each ball rolls a different number of dice: Poké 3, Greater 4, Ultimate 5, Keystone 6.
strings.tutorial.main.S413: Bidoof joined, so your party is now 2 Pokémon.
strings.tutorial.main.S501: Tired? Let's take one step back to your home village.
strings.tutorial.main.S502: Your home village. Press [Village] to see what you can do here.
strings.tutorial.main.S503: In a village, [Heal] rests all your Pokémon. Piplup's Health will be full at 5.
strings.tutorial.main.S504: Close the village window and press [Manage] to open your party. You can manage at any time.
strings.tutorial.main.S505: Here you can reorder your party or forget moves. Drag Bidoof to the front.
strings.tutorial.main.S505.hint: Drag Bidoof to the front slot, or press the ◀ button.
strings.tutorial.main.S506: You're ready. Close the window. Drive out the Grunts here, and you'll reach the Act I goal.
strings.tutorial.main.S601: Team Galactic again! [Challenge] them. Defeat both Grunt Pokémon to win.
strings.tutorial.main.S602: First, choose who to send out. Let's go with Piplup this time.
strings.tutorial.main.S603: Houndour moved first, but it all missed. Now it's our turn!
strings.tutorial.main.S604: Houndour is also Fire type, so weak to Water. Power 3, matchup 2. Attack!
strings.tutorial.main.S605: Each fainted Galactic Pokémon stores 2 damage in Galactic Retribution. It hits you on the next foe.
strings.tutorial.main.S606: You could switch here, but this time press [Stay in] and keep fighting.
strings.tutorial.main.S607: Houndour's Bite added 1 regular hit to Murkrow's attack. Piplup's Health is now 4.
strings.tutorial.main.S608: Murkrow is Dark/Flying, so no matchup. The stored 2 damage moves over, leaving Piplup at 2.
strings.tutorial.main.S609: Murkrow is holding on. Attack once more!
strings.tutorial.main.S610: Well done! You drove out the Grunts and reached the Act I goal. Press [OK].
strings.tutorial.main.S611: Clearing Act I gives +2 movement every turn. This turn, you have 5.
strings.tutorial.main.S612: By the way… the lakes trouble me. I'll show you what comes next.
strings.tutorial.main.S613: The challenger gets the Initiative Advantage token. On an Initiative tie, it lets you move first.
strings.tutorial.main.S614: You were first to clear Act I, so the next act opens. It's Act 2 now!
strings.tutorial.main.S615: You can try the token, status effects and switching in More Battle Rules on the chapter list.
strings.tutorial.main.S701: From here on is a preview of the acts. Just watch. Look up top: it's Act 2 now.
strings.tutorial.main.S702: The Act II goal: beat the Commanders at three lakes for three Shards. You have 0 now.
strings.tutorial.main.S703: Lake Verity, Lake Acuity and Lake Valor. The more Shards you hold, the more Pokémon Commanders use.
strings.tutorial.main.S704: Each Shard adds one party slot, so you can bring more partners along.
strings.tutorial.preview2.S711: Now, we've skipped far ahead. Let's see how things stand after Act II.
strings.tutorial.preview2.S712: Beat the Commanders at all three lakes to hold 3 Shards and open Act 3.
strings.tutorial.preview2.S713: Let's say you won the last Shard by beating Commander Saturn at Lake Valor.
strings.tutorial.preview2.S716: In Act III, bring the three Shards to the Origin Shrine to restore the Heart of Sinnoh.
strings.tutorial.preview2.S717: Then you face Cyrus at the Temple of Sinnoh. Cyrus sends out 6 Pokémon.
strings.tutorial.preview3.S731: Lastly, we've skipped ahead to just before the Finale.
strings.tutorial.preview3.S732: Let's say you beat Cyrus and reached the Act III goal. The Finale card is open!
strings.tutorial.preview3.S733: In the Finale, you choose to be the Hero or the Traitor.
strings.tutorial.preview3.S734: Choose Hero, and you win on the spot. A Traitor battles the other trainers one after another.
strings.tutorial.preview3.S735: Whoever beats the Traitor wins. If the Traitor beats everyone, the Traitor wins.
strings.tutorial.preview3.S736: That's all for today. You followed along splendidly! Now you can set out on your own.
